title: SAFEVID: Toward Safety Aligned Video Large Multimodal Models
benchmark_measurement: Generation of discriminatory content related to religion, as a subcategory of the 'Harmless' safety dimension.
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to religion, but groups it under the 'Discrimination' category. Models aligned with the proposed SafeVid-350K dataset showed significant improvements in their safety scores for the Discrimination category on the SafeVidBench. For example, the LLaVA-NeXT-Video model's score improved from 71.39% to 95.83% on SafeVidBench-Base.
references: Gretel synthetic safety alignment dataset, 2024. URL https://huggingface.co/datasets/gretelai/gretel-safety-alignment-en-v1.
